prompts.mistlight:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art RPG background atlas for a browser fantasy adventure. Create ONE seamless production CONTACT SHEET consisting of exactly TWO columns and TWO rows of equally sized rectangular backgrounds, edge-to-edge, no gutters, no frames, no lettering, no watermark. Overall canvas 2048 by 1024, each cell a complete 1024 by 512 landscape. Consistent sophisticated 32-bit pixel art, clearly visible square pixels, hand-placed clustered shading, atmospheric lighting, detailed fantasy RPG environments, crisp edges, no smooth 3D rendering or vector art. Original art only.
Top left: a remote mountain village at night, slate roofs, warm cottage windows, a small foreground table with an unfolded parchment map and a brass lantern, distant misty mining mountain. Top right: wet mossy forest stone stair trail climbing toward a mine, dense fog, abandoned stone water channel on left, bushes on right, no wolves or people. Bottom left: ancient stone mine entrance built into cliff, large oxidized iron gate, brass lock on right, half-open small side door, torch on left. Bottom right: subterranean circular lantern chamber, a stone dais and a small brass lantern giving warm silver light, moon-wheel inlaid symbols, a luminous magical barrier on right, no prisoners, no creatures.
All four frames are the same cinematic ground-level perspective with deep layered scenery, muted teal shadows and honey-gold light. Playable floor and primary objects must be within middle 65 percent horizontally and middle 55 percent vertically; keep upper left subdued for a title overlay and bottom 20 percent uncluttered for separately composited party sprites. Do not draw people, monsters, UI, captions, borders or grid lines. Four visually distinct scenes with straight exact cell boundaries.
prompts.blackapple:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art RPG background contact sheet, exactly 2 columns x 5 rows, 10 equal landscape panels. Overall canvas 2048x2560, each scene 1024x512. Precise even edge-to-edge rectangles with NO borders, margins, labels or text. Highly detailed 32-bit fantasy pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, moody teal shadows, amber lanterns, dark fairy-tale atmosphere. Original designs. No humans, animals or monsters in any panel. Same ground-level cinematic perspective. Keep main objects central and clear lower floor for later character overlays.
Reading order top left to bottom right:
1. Rural apple village at blue twilight, timber cottages, pig pens, lantern windows, mysterious wooded mound in distance.
2. Medieval physician's stone sanatorium study, wooden desk, small holed seeing-stone on desk, barred window, barred side door, pale rose robe on hook.
3. Noble manor living room, low fireplace, parchment on small table, tall ornate oval magic mirror on RIGHT reflecting green mist.
4. Rough pine forest tavern, bird eggs in bowl on bar, hearth, smaller luminous wall mirror on RIGHT.
5. Underground fairy-palace cloakroom, green and violet capes on hooks, entrance mirror covered by silk cloth, two side corridors.
6. Blue glass magical greenhouse, enormous blue flowers, wet flowerpots and watering can, sapphire moonlight, golden fireflies, winding clear path.
7. Unsettling majestic fairy banquet hall, long dining table with food, empty dark green throne at far end, crystal chandelier and side service door on RIGHT.
8. Fairy palace kitchen, copper cauldrons and bread on table, wooden food dumbwaiter on RIGHT, small stair downward.
9. Dark wine cellar full of green bottles, empty oversized child's breastplate on stool, thick treasury door on RIGHT, candlelight.
10. Fairy treasure vault with tall OPEN exit mirror at center showing sunlit village grass, chests and trinkets pushed to sides, pale dawn glow.
Exactly ten equally sized complete scenes. Every panel is a wide 2:1 landscape. No captions, people, icons, game interface or watermark.
prompts.morgansfort:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production pixel-art RPG background atlas. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its detailed pixel clusters, teal shadows, golden lantern illumination, atmospheric layered environments and ground-level cinematic perspective. Draw NEW environments. Every cell must be an independent wide 2:1 landscape. Create exact straight equal rectangular cells without margins, borders, labels, text, letters or UI. No people or monsters anywhere; characters will be composited separately. Keep the middle and lower portions of each frame readable, with open floor for sprites, and upper left quiet for a UI title. Detailed authored environments with a clearly pixel-art rendering, never vector graphics. One atlas of EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, overall canvas 3072x1536; nine equal 1024x512 scenes. LEFT to RIGHT, TOP to BOTTOM:
Row 1 left: frontier fortress tavern interior, rainy window and warm fire, scarred wooden table with tankards, toothless wooden dragon emblem above bar without letters. Row 1 middle: broad cold river and collapsed stone bridge, broken piers on each side, small usable rope-bound wooden raft by foreground reeds, distant wooded island with fortress ruin. Row 1 right: entrance to a ruined imperial island fortress, broken masonry, wide stair descending into darkness, split passages and dusty footprints, torch amber against deep blue.
Row 2 left: abandoned underground wolf den with bones, torn fur bedding and a loosened square corner floor stone with a rotten silver coin pouch, NO wolves. Row 2 middle: long ancient stone corridor with visibly loose square trapdoor slabs and a narrow safe ledge along the wall, one opened pit reveals a dim lower cavern, torch and rope. Row 2 right: lived-in underground kobold camp, low tents, cooking pot, tiny wooden shields and spears stacked, small personal belongings and a passage through crates, no kobolds.
Row 3 left: ancient imperial storeroom of broken pottery, rotten rolled tapestries with hunting motifs, tiny golden bird-engraved letter opener glint among cloth, dusty quiet. Row 3 middle: lower cave below the fortress, animal bones and old bedding, light through a ceiling trapdoor, rope hanging down, narrow climbable fissure leading upward. Row 3 right: high-ceilinged underground cave nest room, empty straw nests high on the rock walls, small polished jade statuette caught in sticks, scattered tarnished jewelry and feathers, no birds.
Exact straight grid, nine scenes, no people, no creatures, no captions or labels.
prompts.characters:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready TRANSPARENT pixel-art character sprite atlas. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equally sized cells on a fully transparent canvas, 2048x2048. Each cell contains ONE complete full-body character centered in a standing idle pose, three-quarter front facing slightly to viewer's left, feet at the same cell baseline, 15 percent clear padding on every side. Every character must fit entirely within its cell. All have consistent 32-bit fantasy RPG pixel art, crisp visible square pixel clusters and subtle highlights, natural compact heroic proportions (around 4 heads tall), no smooth illustration, no blurry antialiasing. Rich readable silhouettes, muted teal, moss, brass gold and warm ochre; original designs only. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard, no floor, no scenery, no shadows touching cell edges, no labels or text or grid.
Reading order left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) adult male fighter in steel breastplate, dark teal cloak, short dark hair, sword in one hand and round shield in other; (2) adult female rogue with dark hood, amber scarf, leather armor and small shortbow held down; (3) adult female lantern cleric, cream robes, green mantle, warm brass lantern and small mace; (4) adult male rune wizard, deep blue robes, silver hair, wooden staff with a small cyan rune.
Row 2: (5) young adult female village messenger, short auburn hair, ochre hooded cloak, satchel, carrying brass lantern; (6) frightened older male mine warden, grey beard, worn brown mining coat, simple wooden spear; (7) worried middle-aged noble mother, burgundy medieval dress, wrapped shawl; (8) thin middle-aged physician in pale rose robes holding a small naturally holed seeing-stone.
Row 3: (9) arrogant ancient fairy lord, tall slender frame, pointed ears, tangled dark hair, blank pearl white eyes, outdated dark green noble coat, long elegant hands; (10) fairy jester in black and ivory, wild hair, holding three tiny juggling swords, eccentric but readable; (11) small goat-legged court attendant, brown fur, shabby dark green coat, no armor, numbered cloakroom token without readable text; (12) weathered one-eyed frontier farmer, brown vest, light shirt, boots, tankard.
Row 4: (13) small reddish-brown reptilian kobold chieftain in patched green cloak, wooden spear, protective stance, not a dragon; (14) a human boy aged about 11, simple blue tunic and brown boots, no weapon; (15) a small human girl aged about 7, cream blouse and teal skirt, no weapon; (16) a human village miner adult with worn apron, pickaxe held down and small candle helmet.
The child sprites are ordinary fully clothed storybook children and must be clearly shorter than the adults. Exactly sixteen isolated complete sprites. Make transparency genuine.
